item.title: Stock Markets to stay open on Union Budget Day? Here’s complete details
item.description: Indian stock markets will remain open on Sunday, February 1, for live trading during the presentation of the Union Budget. NSE and BSE will conduct a special trading session despite the weekend holiday, allowing investors to react in real time to budget announcements.

item.title: Gold, Silver sink after record rally, MCX sees sharp sell-off; Check prices here
item.description: Gold and silver prices declined steeply on MCX in early trade after touching lifetime highs in the previous session. Silver tumbled over 4 percent, while gold slipped around 3 percent amid profit booking and a stronger US dollar.

item.title: Stock Market opens weak; Nifty slips 0.6% amid global uncertainty
item.description: Indian equity markets opened sharply lower on Friday amid heightened global volatility driven by wild swings in gold and silver prices. The BSE Sensex slipped over 500 points, while the Nifty 50 declined nearly 0.6 per cent in early trade.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: Supreme Court stays UGC Rules, sparks campus debate; Full controversy explained
item.description: The Supreme Court has temporarily stayed the UGC’s new “Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions Regulations,” citing vague language and misuse risks. Designed to curb caste discrimination and ensure equal opportunities, the rules have sparked campus-wide debate over upper caste vs Dalit dynamics and academic freedom.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Transparency in Tamil Nadu Electoral Roll Revision, Grants Time for Voter Verification
item.description: The Supreme Court directed the Election Commission to publicly disclose names excluded from Tamil Nadu’s draft electoral rolls, explain discrepancies, and grant time for verification, stressing transparency, voter rights, and administrative fairness during the Special Intensive Revision exercise.

item.title: PM Modi leads the nation in paying tribute to Bapu on Martyrs’ Day
item.description: On Martyrs’ Day, national leaders paid heartfelt tributes to Mahatma Gandhi, remembering his ideals of truth, non-violence, Swadeshi, and unity, and reaffirming his lasting influence on India’s journey toward a just, self-reliant, and developed nation.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh Horror: Four killed in Gwalior after speeding truck rams into car
item.description: The family was going from Bhind towards Gwalior when a speeding truck coming from behind rammed into the car. After the collision, the truck went out of control and crashed into the bushes on the right side of the road.

item.title: Fake Codeine Syrup Racket: UP Police cancel mastermind Shubham Jaiswal’s passport, red corner Notice Planned
item.description: UP Police intensify action against fake codeine syrup racket as mastermind Shubham Jaiswal’s passport is cancelled and a Red Corner Notice is planned. Authorities aim to extradite him from Dubai and dismantle the entire illegal drug network.

item.title: Friday OTT Releases: ‘Dhurandhar’, ‘Daldal’ and more hit streaming platforms; Know where to watch
item.description: This Friday, January 30, OTT platforms release a host of exciting films and series for binge-watching. Highlights include the spy thriller Dhurandhar on Netflix, crime thriller Daldal on Prime Video, supernatural comedy Servam Maya on JioCinema, Marathi psychological thriller Inspector Vishwas on G5, and sports documentary Miracle: The Boys of '80 on Netflix.

item.title: J&K: Pakistani drones breach LoC in Kupwara; Forced to retreat after Indian Army action
item.description: Around 15 Pakistani drones were detected near the Jodha Makan Beerandori area of the Keran sector after they crossed into Indian airspace. Alert troops immediately responded to the breach.
